node.title: XR coherent GRS split pencils have an exact extra-kernel certificate
node.statement: For a common GRS_4 split-pencil family with received word U, extension direction q, distinct slopes gamma_i, and agreement blocks A_i, stack zero-extended cubic parity checks as M_F=[H_i|-gamma_i H_i]. The unavoidable cubic-pair kernel has dimension eight, while the genuine pair (U,q) supplies a ninth direction whose second projection is noncubic, so rank M_F<=2N-9; rank 2N-8 excludes the proposed family. Moreover, on every six-set the five-face divided-difference colors are a fractional-linear function of the omitted coordinate, hence all defined colors are either pairwise distinct or all equal. This is an exact necessary rank/Plucker certificate interface, not the aggregate split-pencil count.
